verdict.rationale: Replit's first-party docs describe a built-in Agent that breaks work into tasks, runs them in the background in isolated copies of the project, and applies results back to the main version. It also provisions databases and auth for you, and modes let you trade capability against credits. Community reports confirm the agent exists and is actively used, though one well-known report of it deleting a production database raises reliability concerns rather than disproving the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, without destructive or fabricated results.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Agent breaks work into tasks you can review, run in the background, and apply back to your main version.
Background tasks are separate threads where Agent works independently in isolated copies of your project.
Agent provisions it automatically with separate Development and Production environments.
each person can start new threads with Agent while working on the same project.
